comparison.objective: Apply an opaque primer coat to a steel plate, not separate media from parts.
comparison.physical_skill: Brush loading, spreading, and coverage control versus dry granular sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Patch coverage and drip limits with brush released; no screen passage or washer retention.
comparison.reason: Material coating and granular separation test different physical abilities. Rubric versions clarify opacity but remain sufficient.
